decentralised.title: N agents, same task, no shared state, merged by a fixed medoid vote
decentralised.why: No orchestrator. Three independent samples plus an oracle-free vote: of the three candidates keep the one most similar to the other two. That is self-consistency, and it is a real baseline, not a strawman.

centralised.title: An orchestrator splits the task, dispatches workers, and merges
centralised.why: One plan call, three workers each given one subtask plus the same shared input, then a second orchestrator call that sees all three and decides what is kept.

benchmark.title: Nanopub creation
benchmark.metric: mean of 6 honesty checks (parses, leak-clean, locator traceability, quotable line, no invented numbers, no boilerplate reuse)
benchmark.caveat: METRIC CAVEAT: "parses" is 0 for every arm on every task, because the prompt never asked for a provenance template and every record is minutes old — neither is an RDF problem. The post-hoc secondary "parses_valid_rdf", which tolerates those two notes, separates: single 1 of 3, decentralised 3 of 3, centralised 0 of 3 (no artifact). At n = 3 that is one task of difference.
benchmark.reading: This stage appears to separate the arms, but the 0.648 gap is an ARTIFACT-ABSENCE effect, not a quality one: the centralised arm produced no artifact in 3 of 3 cells, with 8 calls stopped at the per-call budget cap. Its merge was starved at the join under equal splitting; re-allocating the same total unevenly produced an artifact in 3 of 3. Read this as "centralisation is budget-fragile at the merge", never as "centralisation writes worse records".

benchmark.title: Design-studio usage
benchmark.metric: mean of 4 checks (accepted, fixed fields present, laws actually evaluated, no unflagged invented fields)
benchmark.caveat: TASK-DESIGN DEFECT: the briefs are infeasible at lawset 1.8.1. All three arms violate the same five binding laws on brief 1, because the sponsor's fixed SL_m 0.25 and mass_kg 0.075 sit outside the Exocoetidae isometry band the accepted laws are scoped to. Re-running lean_check on one arm's own design with SL_m set to the reference specimen's 0.19 drops binding violations from 5 to 0. "accepted" was unreachable by construction, so this stage measures the brief, not the arms. Do not quote its quality column.
benchmark.reading: The 0.151 gap between the best and worst arm sits INSIDE the widest within-arm spread (0.409). At n=3 with single draws and no replicates, this stage does not separate the architectures on quality.
